inputs.price: close of the last closed daily candle (Binance NEARUSDT 1d); the spot reference price is recorded but not read

rule: NEAR weight between 20% and 75%. Trend score: the share of the 10, 20, 40 and 55-day channels whose midpoint (between the prior high and low) the last close is above. Weight = 20% plus 55 points times the score, times min(1, 40% annual volatility / NEAR's realised volatility over 30 daily closes). Trades only when the target is more than 10 points from the current weight.
